title: Flyers & Branding
notes: Still not a real canvas editor (no drag-drop/resize/layers) — flyer content is a structured form (headline/subheadline/offer/contact/color/font) rendered as a live token-based preview, not freeform layout, which matches the backend's flyer.content JSON shape. Flyer template CRUD, template assets endpoints and image upload-logo are now wired (assets endpoint has no UI entry point yet — templates only take a thumbnail/preview URL, not an uploaded asset gallery). Share goes through a segment RelationCombobox + channel select calling POST /marketing/flyers/share, not SendMessageDialog, since flyer share targets a segment rather than a single contact — phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/datePicker/sendMessageDialog are not applicable to this entity's fields.
showcaseScript: Open Marketing → Branding and set the company logo and palette
Open Flyers and pick a festival template
Customise the headline and offer, then generate
Share the flyer to a WhatsApp segment
